in_sanskrit.name: Vr
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Vruksha, meaning tree
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vr एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vr is derived from the Sanskrit word Vruksha, which means tree. The name is associated with growth, stability, and strength.
